Independently, Corollary 4 states unconditional dyadic existence on the positive oriented ray, with a square-root-logarithmic lower bound, and an additional opposite-sign conclusion on the imaginary line. The mean circle therefore records a directional center and positive-real bias, not the density, trajectory, or full distribution of individual values; the large-value claim is existence, not frequency.
